_note: Every source in the corpus. standing = what kind of evidence it is (shown beside every citation). rights = why we may hold its text: India's Copyright Act gives 60 years after the author's death (s.22) or after publication for government works (s.28); s.52(1)(q) lets anyone reproduce Acts, the Gazette, judgments and reports of government-appointed commissions laid before a legislature. Copyrighted books (e.g. Mathai, Reminiscences of the Nehru Age, 1978: author d. 1981, protected to 2041) stay out, even when a copy sits on archive.org.
